text:
alex: seeing a surge of OOMs on prod after the rollout. multiple pods killed, mem usage spikes right after new kv-cache change. link to logs: https://internal/logs/INC-4821 :grimacing:
sophia: ugh, which release? canary or full? :thinking:
alex: deployed v1.14.2 this morning (canary -> 30% -> 100%). canary started failing around 09:12 UTC, then full roll pushed at 09:30. canary was not healthy but autoscaled through failures so it got promoted.
ci-bot: CI perf job failed on merge 8f3b2a4 (kv-evict-refactor). Job: https://ci/redwood/job/serving-perf/3245 -> p95 latency +18%, mem RSS +40% compared to baseline.
jamal: I remember touching that area. PR changed eviction policy to segmented eviction to avoid long LRU scans, but it also changed how we pin KV pages. possible leak.
mar ia: profiling snapshot attached:```heap-snapshot
KVCache.total_entries: 12_456
KVCache.pinned_pages: 7_842
fragmentation_bytes: 4.2GB
allocator_free_list: 120MB
```
maria: also aggregation of seq_len=4096 requests show KV lookups tripled per token after change.
alex: can we bisect quickly? leaving rollout blocked until we understand root cause.
sophia: starting git bisect on prod-relevant commits now. rough range: 8b1f9..9c4e2. will run perf CI on each step.
jamal: quick check — the PR replaced per-shard eviction timers with a global segment queue. That queue consumes additional metadata and holds references longer. Might cause fragmentation + delayed evictions for long sequences.
ci-bot: perf CI step 3/7: commit 9a2c1f -> regressions reproduced (OOMs in perf container). Logs: ```OOM killed process serving-runtime (status 137)
mem before: 24GB, after: 40GB```
sophia: bisect points to commit 9a2c1f (author @jamal). Can we get a minimal repro?
jamal: local repro using stress-serve with sequence-length skew:```./tools/stress --seq-dist heavy --concurrency 16 --profile kv``` reproduces mem growth in ~2min. Patch attached to PR #4587 for quick revert.
mar ia: ran the revert locally, mem graph after revert:```time: 0 30 60 90
memGB(original): 10 12 15 22
memGB(revert): 10 11 11 12```
alex: thanks — hold on revert PR until CI run completes, but pause rollout immediately. I flagged as rollout-blocker in #releases. :no_entry:
sophia: CI green on revert PR -> approving revert. will schedule emergency rollback.
devops-bot: Canary rollback initiated for release v1.14.2 at 10:05 UTC. Observability alerts silenced for the impacted pods.
alex: after rollback, observe memory and p95 for 30m then decide on full redeploy.
maria: note for post-mortem: the segmented eviction change reduced worst-case eviction scan latency but introduced metadata retention that increases fragmentation under heavy seq_len skew. needs a hybrid approach (per-shard + bounded segment queue) and unit tests that simulate long sequences.
jamal: agree. I'll open a follow-up RFC with benchmarks and add eviction stress tests.
alex: good. add a perf CI job that runs long-seq KV stress nightly.
sophia: added ticket PERF-792 to backlog, tagging infra and eng-ml.
maria: thanks all — current memory graphs already trending down after rollback. will post final incident summary in incidents channel in ~1h. :thumbsup:
